specs.name: swap_trivial_equal_fields
specs.stmt: ∀ (v : Std.U32), records.swap { first := v, second := v } = ok { first := v, second := v }

specs.name: swap_correct
specs.stmt: ∀ (p : records.Pair), records.swap p = ok { first := p.second, second := p.first }

specs.name: swap_always_ok
specs.stmt: ∀ (p : records.Pair), ∃ r, records.swap p = ok r

specs.name: swap_first_is_second
specs.stmt: ∀ (p : records.Pair), ∃ r, records.swap p = ok r ∧ r.first = p.second

specs.name: swap_second_is_first
specs.stmt: ∀ (p : records.Pair), ∃ r, records.swap p = ok r ∧ r.second = p.first

specs.name: swap_preserves_values
specs.stmt: ∀ (p : records.Pair), ∃ r, records.swap p = ok r ∧ r.first = p.second ∧ r.second = p.first

specs.name: swap_same_fields_identity
specs.stmt: ∀ (v : Std.U32), ∃ r, records.swap { first := v, second := v } = ok r ∧ r.first = v ∧ r.second = v

specs.name: swap_equiv_explicit
specs.stmt: ∀ (a b : Std.U32), records.swap { first := a, second := b } = ok { first := b, second := a }

specs.name: swap_involution
specs.stmt: ∀ (p : records.Pair), ∃ r1 r2, records.swap p = ok r1 ∧ records.swap r1 = ok r2 ∧ r2.first = p.first ∧ r2.second = p.second

specs.name: swap_swap_eq_original
specs.stmt: ∀ (p : records.Pair), ∃ r, records.swap p = ok r ∧ records.swap r = ok { first := p.first, second := p.second }

specs.name: swap_result_determined
specs.stmt: ∀ (p : records.Pair) (r : records.Pair), records.swap p = ok r → r.first = p.second ∧ r.second = p.first

specs.name: swap_symmetric_pair
specs.stmt: ∀ (p : records.Pair), p.first = p.second → records.swap p = ok p

specs.name: swap_of_swapped_input
specs.stmt: ∀ (a b : Std.U32), records.swap { first := a, second := b } = ok { first := b, second := a } ∧ records.swap { first := b, second := a } = ok { first := a, second := b }
